items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: Because Joe Glaser, a big booker, well he wanted to secure my band, and I put a price and I said you can have it if you give me ten thousand dollars in advance.

ctx.x: For the way the reed section worked?

Yeah. It was Joey Williams. But George Williams, see I didn’t pick out the classic arrangements that he had arranged for Glenn Miller, I picked out the jazz arrangements. So George Williams, I got those arrangements from Williams, and the funny thing about it, we got these arrangements at $10 a piece. At $10 a piece. Because Joe Glaser, a big booker, well he wanted to secure my band, and I put a price and I said you can have it if you give me ten thousand dollars in advance. Well the arrangements were so cheap,…
Good deal. I’ll bet she liked that deal too.
